metadata.title: Vibrant Duotone Portrait with Compressed Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close portrait of a male figure with eyes closed and hands near ears, set against a vibrant orange-to-yellow vertical gradient. The composition is dominated by massive, ultra-compressed blue sans-serif typography in the upper two-thirds, with a secondary handwritten script element in the lower right.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the oversized, rigid headline and the smaller, organic human subject.
Color complementarity between the deep navy-blue ink and the warm orange-yellow background.
Texture integration where a subtle grain or halftone pattern unifies the photographic and typographic layers.
coreInvariants: Vertical color gradient from saturated orange at the top to pale yellow at the bottom.
Subject's shoulders fading into a red-tinted motion blur or soft vignette at the base.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered at the bottom edge, occupying approximately the lower third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive block of text in the upper half acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the boldest text, through the secondary compressed text, landing on the subject's face, then moving to the script signature.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with type and the central figure.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue for all primary typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red-orange glow/blur at the bottom edge of the portrait.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout; dark values are reserved for the ink-like blue of the type and shadows in the portrait.
paletteRestrictions: No cool colors other than the navy blue.
No pure white; highlights are tinted yellow.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (height to width).
Uniform stroke weight with minimal modulation.
Squarish curves in the bowls of letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' is a tall, narrow rectangle with rounded corners.
The 'S' features very short horizontal segments.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid, mechanical sans-serif and fluid, expressive handwriting.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight.
Matches the aggressive compression and flat terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with eyes closed and hands near his head, centered at the bottom of the frame. Apply a vertical gradient background from orange at the top to yellow at the bottom. Apply a navy blue duotone effect to the subject and add a red motion blur at the bottom edge. Add a subtle paper grain or halftone texture over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay large, ultra-condensed navy blue sans-serif text in the top two-thirds of the frame. Add a small, slanted navy blue handwritten script signature in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background a smooth orange-to-yellow gradient?
Is the subject positioned at the bottom center?
Is the color palette strictly navy blue, orange, yellow, and a touch of red?

adjustableVariables: Degree of vertical compression in the font
Amount of red blur at the base
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Specific tattoos or jewelry on the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's face.
Check that the navy blue is consistent across all elements.
Verify the halftone texture is visible but not distracting.
Confirm the script text is legible as a signature element.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Ultra-Condensed Display Type] + [Centered Low-Third Portrait] + [Complementary Duotone Gradient] + [Halftone Overlay] to create a high-energy editorial layout.
